United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. *862Certiorari denied.

Robert W. Kenny, Bartley C. Crum and Martin Popper for petitioner. Solicitor General Perlman for the United States. G. Leslie Field and George W. Crockett, Jr. filed a brief for the National Lawyers Guild, as amicus curiae, supporting the petition. MR. Justice Burton took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
